clips.title: The story
paras: Deliveries to Sven is an Alliance task given by Elaine Carevin in Darkshire, requesting that vital provisions be carried out to a lonely camp on the northwest frontier of Duskwood. There, Sven Yorgen and his few remaining followers wage a desperate, solitary struggle against the horrors of the blighted woods. The errand connects town folk struggling in the gloom with an isolated band on the edge of the wilderness.

While Darkshire barely holds its own walls against wolves, spiders, and the restless dead, some refuse to cower behind palisades. Sven Yorgen and a meager handful of companions established a solitary encampment along the northwestern perimeter of Duskwood. So pressed are they by constant danger that they cannot spare a single man to make the perilous trek back to town for provisions. Elaine Carevin steps in to coordinate aid, relying on brave travelers to ensure these frontier fighters do not starve.

The Carevin family holds high regard for Sven, viewing his fierce stand as true devotion to the Light. Elaine's willingness to organize and dispatch supplies highlights the quiet networks of survival that keep Duskwood from completely collapsing into shadow. When Sven receives the crate, he recognizes the enduring support of the Carevins, though his thoughts remain consumed by the grim battle at hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.
Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look a sturdy type, adventurer. Have you come to join our fight?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
